terms.gloss: an interview (for a job, with a journalist)
terms.comment: Classically a conversation or a meeting held for talks: in colloquium venīre, to come to a parley (Caes. BG 1.35, in Lewis & Short).
Lewis & Short: “to ask, question, inquire, interrogate”. The interviewer is interrogātor (Traupman 334).

terms.latin: interrogātor, interrogātōris m.; interrogātrīx, interrogātrīcis f.

phrases.latin: hinc colloquium cum veniunt in ūnum locum loquendī causā
phrases.english: hence colloquium, when people come together in one place in order to talk

sources: Lewis & Short: colloquium · Lewis & Short: interrogo
Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections (loci-varro), as checked there against the editions they name.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 334.
